1.title: How Louisiana’s New Surgeon General Wants to Transform Public Health
1.summary: Dr. Evelyn Griffin is pushing for more emphasis on wellness and prevention. She has also aligned with the MAHA movement in fighting government mandates and questioning the safety of some vaccines.

2.title: Who Is the New White House Counsel?
2.summary: President Trump appointed his former personal lawyer Will Scharf as White House counsel. Maggie Haberman, our White House correspondent, explains how Scharf might help the president avoid congressional oversight at a critical time.

3.title: UK PM Burnham exchanged messages with White House imposter
3.summary: Downing Street has declined to comment on the security breach, first reported by Politico.

4.title: Trump’s Overture to North Korea Strains Alliance With the South
4.summary: President Trump wants to curtail military exercises with South Korea, saying they were hostile to North Korea. But under Mr. Kim, the North has become increasingly belligerent toward the South.

5.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
5.summary: The authorities allege they were involved in an insurrection plot but the leading opposition candidate says there was an attempt on his life.

6.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
6.summary: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.
